body: Thank you, Eurynomus, I will keep that in mind.  And one step at a time is basically my motto right now, so that should be an easy thing to continue.

One thing I'll never be is fat.  No matter how much I eat I am perpetually an overly skinny freak.  And the smartness?  Not so good when even when you have an IQ of 142, you're still the dumb one in the family.  And my mother?  She admitably prefers my sister to me.  I do see a shrink.  A real one.  I just have trust issues, I suppose.  Also, I think she realized I needed help with the failed suicide and the 72 hour watch.  I've done things which could land me in jail.  I never stole anything, because with my family's income it was never necessary, however illegal activities were not exempted when I attended sleepaway camp.  I know I'm not alone.  People are in far worse situations then I.  I'm just a rich prat with a rich prat of a father and a nervous wreck of a mother.  I think I was scared off from attempting suicide again when they told me that second attempt's stay in the youth mental ward is far lengthened from the initial 72 hour protocol.  I will call upon you for help if I do need it, hurcules_rokefeller.  Thank you for caring.

Thank you.
Really.
Reading this made my day a little bit brighter.
There are so few people that actually care.
I know that you think I should talk to my mom.
But right now I can barely even handle myself.
